purpose: Qualify the real load driver, completion observer and recipient accounting before any performance comparison.

reporting.claim: Driver and observer qualification only; local timings are diagnostic, not performance or capacity evidence.
reporting.completion_interval: Last incomplete count request start to first complete count response end; both raw observations are retained.
reporting.failure_rule: Every planned action and recipient must be accounted for. Errors, missing events, wrong recipients, incomplete batches and changed controls cannot pass. No mutation is retried.

subsequent_performance_gate.not_authorized_by_this_file: This qualification runner must not automatically execute the candidate performance matrix or claim a speedup across different routing semantics.
